name: ORB - tighter stop/target
description: This strategy trades the opening range breakout. After market open (9:30am est) we wait for the first 15min candle to close. After close, we wait for the breakout either to the upside or the downside. After breakout we can either enter on breakout or on retest, I still don't know which one is better. To exit I still don't know the take profit or the stop loss. Figure out where we cna put stop loss and take profit so that we always get a 1:2 risk to reward ratio as a minimum. it can be more, and we should strive for more but minimum 1:2
rationale: Original backtest 8347b3617e02: 97% of exits were session_end (86/89 trades), meaning the 0.3% stop / 2.5R target (~15-18pt stop, ~38-45pt target) rarely resolved within the 13:30-16:00 window. Halving the stop to 0.15% while keeping the 2.5R ratio shrinks target to ~18-22pt so trades have a real chance to hit stop or target before session end.
